pages.text:
QX80 Interior
DESIGN INTRICACIES
The available diamond pattern on the captain’s
chairs features perforations with dot-quilting to
create a subtle pillowing effect. Rather than
abruptly ending, the pattern gently fades as it
reaches the edge of the seat. Similar in subtlety,
the available luxurious wrapped interior panels
are hand-stretched and fitted to elevate what
would otherwise be ordinary. It’s a detail that
requires the delicate touch of a skilled artisan.

QX80 SPORT
EXTERIOR EXPRESSION
Make a more striking impression with the new-
for-2026 QX80 SPORT. The SPORT refines the
front fascia and grille with a unique front
bumper, while unique SPORT 22-inch wheels
enhance the vehicle’s bold profile. Black roof
rails2 and mirror caps add a sleek look, and the
dark chrome exterior trim imbues an extra
touch of sophistication. Altogether, it’s an
exterior that radiates dynamic elegance.
Unique SPORT front fascia and grille
22-inch unique SPORT aluminum-alloy wheels and black roof rails2

QX80 Driver Assist Technology
VISIBILITY FEATURES
See through space and time, in full view, on dual
14.3” displays.4,7 The near-180-degree Front
Wide View camera shows you what’s around
the corner without needing to pull forward. Or,
if you need to see what’s under you, the
Invisible Hood View projects an image of what’s
directly in front of the QX80 to spot the curb,
the track at the car wash or a runaway soccer
ball.20

Invisible Hood View20
